answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Work waits on the ferrous until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the quartz of the next round. By the vine of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, reduced by each unverified claim, idle agents bleed standing. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
